items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Ever hear of St. Marie, she came out of a school like yours

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Ever hear of St. Marie, she came out of a school like yours, ever hear of Billy Mills the Olympic miler who won the mile overseas in the Olympics -- Billy Mills was a Sioux Indian. I'd go on and talk about famous Indians that have made it. "You can make it." And I told them, "I started out in an Indian School just like you and when I was 11 years old I was supposed to be assigned to the dairy, I was going to learn how -- at 11 years old they send you out to learn something, they had me on the dairy detail to go…
It sounds great, it sounds like a beautiful thing.
